question: Does NInfer Qwen3.8-27B v3 retain a measured speed advantage over the exact current SOL launch profile?

profiles.control: SOL Frozenlock AutoRound INT4/W4A8=1 · vLLM0.27.1 · TP2 · MTP4 · max-model-len262144 · max-num-seqs8 · max-batched-tokens8192 · GPU memory utilization 0.90
profiles.candidate: NInfer0.16.0-rtx3090 Qwen3.8-27B imatrix-v3 · GPU1 · ctx32768 · DFlash2+ngram

gate.speed_claim: at least 10% lower median E2E in >=2/5 matched cells and zero errors/OOM
gate.quality_adoption: remains rejected by Q32 quality/security results; no agent adoption even if speed gate passes

implementation: Use Q32 exact deterministic prompt generator and sampling. SOL runs through a copied Compose project with only loopback port/container name isolated; NInfer uses its pinned model/runtime on GPU1. No product config, server or weights touched.

amendments.attempt01: SOL reached /v1/models after 232.9s; first 8-token warmup returned HTTP500 EngineCore failure before measured requests; no OOM/restart; owned container cleaned and no inference server remains
amendments.attempt02: one diagnostic request only, minimal body with reasoning_effort=medium; capture container logs before cleanup; if it fails, no third startup; if it passes, remove redundant sampling fields from SOL requests and run matrix once

diagnostic_result.diagnostic_interpretation: endpoint accepted a minimal request and stayed running; output budget was consumed by reasoning; log contains TritonBundler missing-cubin warnings, but the first HTTP500 root cause was not reproduced or confirmed

amendments.basis: A2 received HTTP200 with server-side sampler and remained healthy; the prior failing request included redundant sampling overrides. Root cause remains unproven, so the matched matrix is the one allowed discriminator.
amendments.change: run the preregistered 5-cell × 3-repetition direct comparison once, using a fresh attempt directory; omit request-level sampling fields only for SOL because its compose profile already fixes identical sampler values; retain NInfer request parameters, prompts, order, output cap, gates, profiles, and metrics unchanged; capture SOL container logs before cleanup on success or failure
amendments.stop_rule: one measured matrix only; any HTTP/runtime error, token mismatch, OOM, or resource gate aborts the comparison and no third SOL startup is allowed

outcome.adoption: do not adopt for tool agents; Q32 quality/security gate remains failed
